# Bedrooms & More

> > Seattle-based luxury furniture and natural bedding retailer specializing in eco-friendly bedroom solutions, organic mattresses, and premium brands like Hästens, Vispring, and Greenington.

Bedrooms & More operates showrooms in Seattle's Wallingford neighborhood and a Clearance Outlet, offering expert guidance on natural and organic sleep products, sustainable furniture, and home furnishings. The store emphasizes OEKO-TEX certified materials, eco-friendly manufacturing, and educational content about mattress materials, off-gassing, and healthy sleep environments.

## Key Topics

- Natural & organic mattresses
- OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certification
- Eco-friendly furniture
- Hästens luxury bedding
- Latex vs memory foam
- Off-gassing and mattress materials
- Greenington bamboo furniture
- Vispring flippable mattresses
- 45th Street Bedding
- Night & Day Furniture
- Sustainable sleep products
- Mattress buying guides
- Children's natural bedding
- Seattle Wallingford showroom
- Clearance Outlet deals

## Mattress Buying Guides

- [Mattress Buyers' Guide to Off-Gassing | Seattle](https://bedroomsandmore.com/blog/mattress-buyers-guide-to-off-gassing): Guide to identifying off-gassing materials in memory foam & other mattresses
- [Greenwashing Mattresses: Is Latex Eco-Friendly or are you being tricked?](https://bedroomsandmore.com/blog/eco-friendly-latex-or-greenwashing): Exposing greenwashing in latex mattresses: natural vs synthetic materials
- [Find the Best Foam Mattress | Bedrooms & More Seattle](https://bedroomsandmore.com/blog/the-best-foam-mattress): Expert guide to latex, memory foam & gel foam mattress materials
- [[Video] A Flippable Mattress Changes Everything | Bedrooms & More](https://bedroomsandmore.com/blog/video-flippable-mattress-changes-everything): Video guide to two-sided flippable mattresses from Vispring & Hästens
